# Contributing to Ender-Development.org

Feel free to contribute to any of our projects. We are always happy about pull requests.
If you want to help us, you can find potential tasks in the issue tracker of the respective repository.
Of course, you can also create new issues if you find a bug or have a suggestion for a new feature.
Should you have any questions, feel free to ask us on [Discord](https://discord.gg/JF7x2vG).
